summary.text: Dick Anderson is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 5, which his legislative page associates with Lincoln City, and was elected to the Senate in 2020.
He is the former mayor of Lincoln City.

paragraphs.text: Anderson was raised in Wallowa County and lived in several areas of the Northwest during his career, according to his biography, which says he worked 35 years in the financial industry before moving to the Oregon coast.

As mayor of Lincoln City he served on the Lincoln County Foundation and the Oregon Coastal Zone Management Executive Committee, and he serves on the North Lincoln Health District Board and the Siletz Tribal Charitable Contribution Board.

He and his wife, Sue, have two children and five grandchildren, and he has volunteered with the North Lincoln County Community Emergency Response Team, B'nai B'rith Camp and Family Promise of Lincoln County.
